subject: Joint webinar: Redwood x Lumina - product ops + observability
messages:
From: Sofia Martinez <sofia@lumina-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Shahid Khan <shahid@lumina-analytics.com>, partners@lumina-analytics.com
Date: 2026-03-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Partnership idea — co-hosted webinar on product ops + observability

Hi Marissa —

Hope you’re well. I’m Sofia on Lumina’s partnerships & marketing team. We’ve been tracking how product teams are instrumenting LLM features in production and think there’s a tidy joint narrative between Lumina’s monitoring toolbox and Redwood’s inference controls. Would Redwood be interested in co-hosting a 45-minute webinar (30m talk + 15m Q&A) in April/May?

Rough outline we had in mind:
- Short customer kickoff: Why inference observability matters
- Demo: joint workflow (instrumentation → alerts → model rollback)
- Best practices: cost vs. quality tradeoffs
- Live Q&A

We can lead promotion through our newsletter + customer invites; would love if Redwood could lead the demo portion and supply a couple of speaker slots. Attached is a short SOW and a few slide examples to show tone.

Can you share a couple of available weeks? We’re flexible and happy to coordinate co-branding.

Best,
Sofia Martinez
Head of Partnerships & Marketing, Lumina Analytics
attachments: Lumina_Redwood_Webinar_SOW.pdf, Lumina_Slide_Examples.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia@lumina-analytics.com>
Cc: Shahid Khan <shahid@lumina-analytics.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership idea — co-hosted webinar on product ops + observability

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the thoughtful proposal — this aligns with a few GTM plays we’re running for Q2. Redwood would love to partner. High-level thoughts:

- Speaker mix: suggestion — Vivek (partnerships intro), me (product/business context), Rishi (demo of routing + observability hooks).
- Format: 40m content + 20m live Q&A seems safer given technical demos.
- Timing: we’re open the weeks of Apr 20, May 4 or May 18.

I’ve CC’d Vivek to coordinate ops and Rishi for the demo planning. I can book a 30m sync if any of those work — my calendar: https://cal.com/redwood/marissa/30

Happy to review the SOW and co-branding guidance in the next sync.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Partnerships, Redwood Inference
attachments: —

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-04T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Partnership idea — co-hosted webinar on product ops + observability

Marissa / Rishi / Laura —

Quick internal note before we lock dates with Lumina: a few operational items to confirm so we don’t get pinged later:

- Sponsorship budget: do we want a paid promo on Lumina’s newsletter? If yes, what’s the spend cap?
- SLAs for co-branding: who on legal will sign off on the co-branded assets? (looping Laura for approvals flow)
- Demo environment: Rishi, will you need Redwood infra access or a recording of the demo to avoid live flakiness?

If we’re good on the above, I’ll propose May 4 as our preferred date and ask Lumina for a joint comms plan.

Vivek
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
attachments: —

From: Shahid Khan <shahid@lumina-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-06T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership idea — co-hosted webinar on product ops + observability

Thanks, Marissa and team — excited to proceed. Quick answers to Vivek’s ops list:

- Newsletter promo: yes, we can include a sponsored blurb. Typical promo fee is $1,500; we’ll waive it for a co-marketing pilot if Redwood provides a co-signed case study later.
- Legal/co-branding: we have a simple co-marketing addendum that legal typically signs; we can send it to Laura.
- Demo reliability: we prefer a hybrid approach — live demo for 10–15 mins, recording for the heavier workflow sections in case of issues. Attached are bios for our proposed speakers and a short doc with slide tone examples.

Proposed speakers from Lumina: Sofia (partnerships/why this matters), Shahid (customer success + use cases). Would you share Redwood bios for the registration page?

Atts: Lumina_Speaker_Bios.docx, Lumina_Slide_Examples.pdf

Cheers,
Shahid Khan
Head of Customer Success, Lumina Analytics
attachments: Lumina_Speaker_Bios.docx

Subject: RE: Partnership idea — co-hosted webinar on product ops + observability (confirmed)

Sofia / Shahid —

This sounds great. We’d like to confirm May 4, 2026 at 10:00 AM PT for the webinar (45–60 min window). Next steps from Redwood’s side: 

1) Speaker bios & slides: Rishi will send a co-branded slide template and short Redwood bios by Fri 3/13.
2) Legal: Laura — please review Lumina’s co-marketing addendum; we’ll track signatures via DocuSign (DocuSign: 0A12-LUM-REDW-2026).
3) Promo: we accept Lumina’s sponsored blurb waiver for this pilot; marketing will plan a joint social cadence.
4) Demo plan: Rishi proposes a 12-min live demo + recorded walkthrough for the integration; we’ll do a dry run on 4/27.

I’m attaching a co-branded slide template and our GTM checklist for partner events to speed things up. Can you confirm the list of registrant fields you want on the signup form (company, role, use-case)? Also please send your headshots for the registration page.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Partnerships, Redwood Inference
